zh-Hant.title: 鍵盤更穩，講話不再被中途切斷
zh-Hant.body: 切換 app 幾次之後鍵盤不會再自己消失。單次語音輸入延長到 10 分鐘，結束前會倒數；連線中斷時，已經講的內容照樣貼上。
zh-Hant.also: 上一段講完 30 秒內再講不用跳回 Parley。打字也更順：鍵與鍵之間點得到、按下立即反應、長按刪除會加速。

en.title: A steadier keyboard that doesn't cut you off
en.body: The keyboard no longer disappears after a few app switches. A dictation can run for 10 minutes and counts down before it ends, and if the connection drops, what you said is still typed.
en.also: Dictate again within 30 seconds without leaving the app you're in. Typing is smoother too: taps between keys land, keys respond instantly, and held delete speeds up.
